purpose: repair of a palace or shrine built by an earlier Licchavi king
notes: Highly fragmentary inscription; mentions a structure or foundation made long ago by an ancient Licchavi king (cirantanaṃ licchavirāja-kāritaṃ) and neglected by previous retainers/guards (purātanair vvṛttibhaṭair upekṣitaṃ). No individual personal names or dates are preserved.
